messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: Rack r16 sensors reporting oscillating inlet temps and repeated powercap events (x3) over last 5m. Affected hosts: r16-n[01-04]. GPU throttles + 2 evictions.
hannah: seeing the same in grafana — temp sawtooth every ~30s, fan PWM toggling.
mike: observed increased Xid 31s on r16-n02 around the same window. logs attached in thread.
sajal: can we quickly route traffic off r16? we have a canary model serving there.
julia: @ops-oncall can you drain r16-n[01-04] and move model traffic to eu-west2-pool-B? priority: keep latency SLO.
ops-oncall: starting drain for r16-n01 now. clusterctl drain --node r16-n01 --ignore-daemonsets
ops-oncall: r16-n01 cordoned, pods evicted. will watch for remaining inflight tokens. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
infra-bot: NOTE: NVML reports persistent ECC corrected counts on r16-n02 GPU0 and GPU2. Also transient Xid 31 kernel messages.
hannah: pulling sensor logs: "inlet_temp: 36 -> 48 -> 34 -> 49" across cycles, chassis ambient sensor and GPU fan tach disagreeing.
mike: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,fan.speed,power.limit --format=csv -i 0,1 shows fan speed oscillation 30% -> 90% every 25s.
sajal: suspicious — could be sensor miscalibration or fan control hysteresis. any recent PSU/firmware changes in that rack?
julia: not that I can see. last fw push was 12d ago, unaffected racks show stable traces.
ops-oncall: field-tech scheduled to check r16 at 16:15 UTC, will re-seat top-of-rack ambient sensor and check fan cabling.
field-tech: onsite: confirmed one ambient sensor header is loose on the left PDU shelf. reseated, performed quick thermal stress run, fan oscillation less pronounced but still present under load.
hannah: after reseat, inlet volatility reduced but we still see short spikes when model batches align.
mike: added temporary workaround in routing: redirect heavy-batch inference requests away from r16 until further notice. updated routing policy, bumping canary weight down to 0.
sajal: for longer term: propose enabling sensor-value smoothing in telem agent (10s rolling avg) + alert threshold hysteresis to avoid thrash, and set fan PWM min floor to 40% for that chassis.
julia: agree. open a config PR for telem-agent and fan-profile. tag: eng-infra + eng-runtime for review.
ops-oncall: reboots done on r16-n02 and r16-n03. no new Xid messages after soft-reboot, ECC corrected counters continuing but not increasing.
infra-bot: METRICS: inference latency for impacted service increased 12% during the oscillation window; error rate bump +0.6%.
mike: cost/impact note — rerouting to other pools added ~3% additional GPU cost due to less efficient batching; tracker updated in #finance-impact.
sajal: action items: 1) patch telem smoothing (PR#1542), 2) update fan-profile on chassis (PR#1543), 3) field tech to replace ambient sensor (case opened), 4) schedule 2hr maintenance to swap r16-n02 GPU if ECC persists.
julia: timeline: quick fixes (1-2h) for smoothing/fan-floor, hardware swap if counters don't stabilize within 48h.
field-tech: ordered replacement ambient sensor, ETA 1 business day.
hannah: adding a small unit test to the telem ingestion pipeline to catch sawtooth patterns (reduce noisy-alerts).
mike: will keep tracking Xid/ECC. if we see recurrence post-swap, escalate to vendor for possible card defect.
ops-oncall: leaving nodes cordoned until post-maint. will uncordon only after explicit sign-off.
sajal: thanks all — nice quick coordination. please paste final incident note in /incidents and tag postmortem if replacement occurs. :thumbsup:
julia: filing brief incident note now.
infra-bot: INCIDENT NOTE CREATED: r16-thermal-sawtooth-2065432109 — details in /incidents/r16-thermal-sawtooth-2065432109.md
